note: The interest_rate tag sits in every cell, and for '#% (incl. #% PIK)' n1 equals interest_rate while n2 equals pik_rate, so n1 is the all-in rate and n2 is its PIK part. Pure '#% PIK' cells are tagged as pik_rate (41 of 42 rows); the one row tagged interest_rate is a minor exception. The reference rate and spread are in a separate column.
